english.title: Abandon property on a highway, on land in the open air - Refuse Disposal (Amenity) Act 1978
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority, abandoned on land
(A)_[in the open air,]_
(B)_[forming part of a highway,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),

(C)_[a motor vehicle]_
(D)_[part of a motor vehicle removed from it in the course of dismantling the vehicle on the land]_
(E)_[an item, namely **(..SPECIFY ITEM..), being a thing which you brought to the land for the purpose of abandoning it there]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(1) of the Refuse Disposal (Amenity) Act 1978.

english.notes:

(ii) DVLA code added under section 146 Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 and in accordance with and H.O.C. 59/2003.
(iii) See also fixed penalty notices.
